[[CSD Suchitepéquez|Suchitepéquez]] 7–0 [[Universidad de San Carlos CF|USAC]] (September 19) |matches = 132 |total goals = 320 |prevseason = [[2009–10 Liga Nacional de Guatemala|2009–10]] |nextseason = [[2011–12 Liga Nacional de Guatemala|2011–12]] }} The '''2010–11 Liga Nacional de Guatemala''' was the 58th professional season of the top-flight football league in [[Guatemala]]. The season was divided into two championships—the [[#Apertura|2010 Apertura]] and the [[#Clausura|2011 Clausura]]—each in an identical format and each contested by the same 12 teams. ==Format== The format for both championships are identical. Each championship will have two stages: a first stage and a playoff stage. The first stage of each championship is a double round-robin format. The teams that finishes 1 and 2 in the standings will advance to the playoffs semifinals, while the teams that finish 3–6 will enter in the quarterfinals. The winner of each quarterfinals will advance to the semifinals. The winners of the semifinals will advance to the finals, which will determine the tournament champion.{{Cite web |title=Guatemala 2010/11 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesg/guat2011.html |access-date=2025-06-11 |website=www.rsssf.org}} ==Teams== {{Location map+|Guatemala|width=325|float=right|caption=Location of the '''2010–11 Liga Nacional de Fútbol de Guatemala''' teams|places= {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=14.625764|long=-90.510489|label=Guatemala City|position=top}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=16.981838|long=-89.903973|label=[[Heredia Jaguares de Peten|Heredia]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=14.333333|long=-89.716667|label=[[Deportivo Mictlán|Mictlán]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=14.967560|long=-91.791139|label=[[Deportivo Marquense|Marquense]]|position=top}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=15.314722|long=-91.476111|label=[[Peñarol La Mesilla|Peñarol LM]]|position=right}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=14.845833|long=-91.518889|label=[[Club Xelajú MC|Xelajú]]|position=top}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=14.533333|long=-91.683333|label=[[Juventud Retalteca|Juv. Retalteca]]|position=top}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=14.531531|long=-91.509042|label=[[CD Suchitepéquez|Suchitepéquez]]|position=right}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=15.314722|long=-91.476111|label=[[Deportivo Xinabajul|Xinabajul]]|position=left}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=14.9|long=-92.049722|label=[[Deportivo Malacateco|Malacateco]]|position=bottom}}
